text: Six thirty, at the Ta-zeez methanol plant. Production is four percent below target, and the signals are spread across the whole plant.
The Operations Agent sees it coming. A decline in synthesis loop recycle flow, traced through compression, distillation and storage, all the way to the next cargo.
It convenes a council of specialist agents. Process, asset, energy, quality, engineering, and H.S.E. investigate together, in seconds rather than hours.
Their conclusion. The synthesis loop compressor is losing throughput, with eighty seven percent confidence. Around one hundred tonnes per day are at stake, and most of it is recoverable.
The A.I. recommends an investigation plan, but it never acts on the plant. The shift supervisor decides, and every step is logged.
The Asset Agent ranks equipment by risk, so engineers know which machine needs them next.
Energy and production agents close the performance gap, with advisory operating envelopes for throughput, energy, and quality.
Engineering knowledge is one question away. Cited answers from procedures, manuals, and incident history, in English and Arabic.
Every shift starts with a clear, A.I. drafted handover. Good morning. Three things need you today.
And it is governed by design. Agents read and recommend. They never write to the D.C.S. or the safety systems. People stay accountable.
Nine agentic capabilities. One intelligent operating layer, from plant signals to human decisions.
